game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf, the merchant wharf: the sailor must handle storm gulls while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Else Escape: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of storm gulls, dodge the other.
theme: Coastal Port – Merchant Wharf: the merchant wharf
core_gameplay_loop: In Merchant Wharf, repeat each round: Handle both branches of if/else: attack one kind of storm gulls, dodge the other. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the hero_hp value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the signal flag using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The signal flag reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the signal flag is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 10 (extended tier): Else Escape
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Else Escape' (Week 3 slot 2), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Merchant Wharf'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how hero_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm gulls in Merchant Wharf.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The signal flag reached with actions_used <= 19.
